import datetime as dt

# Simulating what the code does
value = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 17, 0, tzinfo=dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=11)))

python << 'EOF'
import datetime as dt
from freezegun import freeze_time
from humanize.time import naturalday, _abs_timedelta

@freeze_time("2023-10-15 23:00:00+00:00")
def test():
    value = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 17, 0, tzinfo=dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=11)))
    
    original_value = value
    
    # Replicate naturaldate logic exactly
    if isinstance(value, dt.datetime) and value.tzinfo is not None:
        today_dt = dt.datetime.now(value.tzinfo)
        today = today_dt.date()
    else:
        today = dt.date.today()
    
    print(f"original_value = {original_value}")
    print(f"value (after date extraction) = {value}")
    print(f"today_dt from dt.datetime.now(value.tzinfo) = {today_dt}")
    print(f"today_date = {today}")
    
    val_date = dt.date(original_value.year, original_value.month, original_value.day)
    print(f"val_date = {val_date}")
    
    delta_raw = val_date - today
    print(f"delta_raw = {delta_raw}, days={delta_raw.days}")
    
    delta = _abs_timedelta(delta_raw)
    print(f"delta after _abs_timedelta = {delta}, days={delta.days}")
    
    result = naturalday(original_value)
    print(f"naturalday(original_value) = {result}")

test()
EOF
